definition_of_245: Count of consumer identities (scanners plus watchlists, 382 in total) for which the earlier private crosswalk records no single explicit numerical candidate owner. Unit: consumers. 220 scanners + 25 watchlists. It is not a count of operands, fields or joins.

gap_class_definitions.MISSING_PRODUCER_STORY: at least one operand needs a numbered story that does not exist yet (proposed: cohort normalization, retracement level, mean companion, per wave 1 decisions C1/A1/B3)
gap_class_definitions.AMBIGUOUS: a numbered owner exists but an exact-profile selection, baseline-reuse proof, variant decision or root choice is pending, or the consumer is declared without a selected emitter
gap_class_definitions.REPRESENTATION_SLOT: operand is a field flagged representation-or-supplied in the public coverage index and routed to an I/O layer
gap_class_definitions.SUPPLIED_FACT_IO_MAPPING: operand is a supplied fact or flag (heuristic role class) needing adapter mapping only
gap_class_definitions.COVERED: every operand has a proposed numbered owner and no pending selection; no row-level operand contract exists, so it is still a gap
